title: Crispy Cast Iron Stovetop Baby Potatoes
description: Halved baby potatoes parboiled in baking soda water, then seared cut-side down in a 12-inch cast iron skillet for a craggy crust and creamy middle, finished with garlic butter.

ingredients.name: baby potatoes
ingredients.note: halved; quarter any larger than 2 inches

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Add {water} and {boilsalt} to a large pot and bring to a boil. Pull the pot off the heat briefly and stir in {soda} (it foams up), then return to the burner and add {potatoes}. Return to a boil and cook 7-9 minutes, until a fork slides in easily and the cut edges look slightly fuzzy. Start checking at 7 minutes.

steps.title: Drain and steam-dry
steps.text: Drain {potatoes} in a colander and let them steam-dry for 5 minutes. Do not rinse.

steps.title: Rough up and season
steps.text: Return {potatoes} to the dry pot. Add {salt}, {paprika}, {granugarlic}, {granuonion}, {umami}, and {pepper}. Cover and shake gently for 10 seconds to scuff up the cut edges.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.text: Heat a 12-inch cast iron skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes. Add {oil} and heat until it shimmers.

steps.title: Sear cut-side down
steps.text: Carefully place {potatoes} cut-side down in a single layer. Lower heat to medium. Do not touch for 6-7 minutes.

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.text: Flip {potatoes} with a thin spatula, scraping up any stuck crust. Cook 8-10 more minutes, turning occasionally, until the skins are crisp and golden on most sides. Lower the heat slightly if the paprika smells scorched.

steps.title: Garlic butter finish
steps.text: Turn heat to low. Push {potatoes} to the sides, melt {butter} in the center, and stir in {jarredgarlic} for 30 seconds. Toss to coat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Remove from heat, toss with {parsley}, and serve immediately.

notes: Make-ahead: parboil, steam-dry, and season the potatoes the day before, then refrigerate uncovered. Pan-fry straight from the fridge, adding 2-3 minutes. Reheat leftovers in the skillet or in the Anova Precision Oven at 400°F, 0% steam, about 10 minutes. Do not crowd the pan; if the skillet is smaller than 12 inches, fry in two batches. Very small potatoes (under 1.5 inches) can stay whole: boil 6-8 minutes and flatten each one slightly with a spatula after the first sear for more crust.
